$comment: V2-06 06-08 G3 screenshot set (roadmap V2-06 acceptance 2; PO action 06-P6). One entry per screen: screenshot-set.spec.ts captures each at its widths into evidence/06-08/screens/<width>/<id>.png with <id>.json (axe, scroll), and scripts/design/screenshot-index.mjs writes the index against the G2-D brand-theme references at referenceCommit (linked, not copied). `reference.dir` is a folder under referenceRoot with <width>.png files; a width the reference lacks is matched to the nearest one and marked. `axeGate`: the spec fails on a serious or critical violation in `axeScope`.
